description: List the latest House of Commons votes, newest first, with date, time, title, Aye and No totals and which side won. Good for "what did MPs vote on today or this week?". Source: UK Parliament Commons Votes API. Divisions appear once the Commons publishes them, usually within an hour of the vote; use commons_division_result with a division_id for the names on each side, and lords_division_search for Lords votes. (cost: 1 credit)

take.description: int, optional, number of divisions to return, 1-25, default 10

name: commons_recent_divisions
